stem.text: Which statement about a macromolecule is correct?

A.text: Amylose is a branched polymer made of $\alpha$-glucose and $\beta$-glucose monomers.

B.text: DNA is an association of two polymers made of nucleotide monomers.

C.text: Haemoglobin is an association of four polymers made up of monomers of haem groups and amino acids.

D.text: Triglycerides are polymers made of fatty acids and glycerol.
